topics.title: Characteristics and classification of living organisms

objectives.text: Describe the characteristics of living organisms by defining the terms: – movement as an action by an organism causing a change of position or place – respiration as the chemical reactions in cells that break down nutrient molecules and release energy – sensitivity as the ability to detect and respond to changes in the environment – growth as a permanent increase in size – reproduction as the processes that make more of the same kind of organism – excretion as removal from organisms of toxic materials and substances in excess of requirements – nutrition as taking in of materials for energy, growth and development
